name: Fee Paying Student Visa

qualifying_event.description: For international students with a formal offer of place from an approved New Zealand education provider.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Offer of place letter; proof of funds; health/travel insurance; (under-18) accommodation/guardianship arrangements.

requirements.blocker_text: A formal offer of place from an approved education provider, stating course name, duration, and study mode.
NZD 20,000 per year of study (or NZD 1,667/month for shorter programmes) in available funds.
Travel and medical insurance acceptable to the education provider, covering from course start through visa expiry (PhD students exempt).

evidence_required.document: Offer of place from an approved provider

outcome.duration_length: up to 4 years, matched to paid study period or passport expiry, whichever is sooner

sources.title: Immigration New Zealand -- Fee Paying Student Visa: offer-of-place requirement, NZD 20,000/year (tertiary) or NZD 17,000/year (school) funds, health insurance, under-18 accommodation rules, up to 25 hrs/week work during study plus full-time in holidays, up to 4-year validity

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (New Zealand). work_rights modeled 'restricted' per the confirmed 25 hours/week (full-time during scheduled holidays) allowance, contingent on visa conditions and provider approval for minors. Compulsory-education (Years 1-13) funds figure (NZD 17,000/year or NZD 1,417/month) is lower than the tertiary figure modeled as the hard requirement here -- the lower school-age figure is disclosed but not separately gated since this file targets the more common tertiary/English-language case.
